text: Okay, the Feldmark invoice. An air compressor for eight thousand four hundred.
Booked to small tools, that's wrong for a compressor.
You switched the cost center to Production — why was that needed?
Equipment over 5,000 is always capex here, so it goes to Plants and Machineries and the Production cost center, never to small tools.

Got it, thanks.
Same amount as the December invoice that we already paid.
You put that purchase invoice on hold — why did it need to be held?
This supplier double-bills every December; hold it until they confirm. Same amount, just a suffix on the old invoice number.
Got it, thanks.
Pennick, that's for the UK company, in pounds.
You sent that invoice for a second approval — why does it need two approvals?
Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.
Got it, thanks.
